checks.detail: T8 TaskSpec envelope binds allowed_files (six t8 evidence files, autonomous_runner.py, and test_automation_resilience.py), forbids every other campaign/control-plane module, data/KBase, scheduler/ACL, user files, strategy, requirements, and non-owned tests; payload_sha256 matches canonical serialization.

All eighteen input evidence references hash-match the live repository: P6 approval, scope manifest, implementation baseline, T1 task report/validation/completion, and T2 through T7 task reports and completions; baseline_sha256 matches implementation_baseline.json.

The only tracked source changes are autonomous_runner.py and tests/test_automation_resilience.py; data, KBase, strategy, policy, scheduler/ACL, user files, and all other control-plane modules are untouched.

_require_legacy_candidate_stamp enforces the immutable provenance stamp (controller_created=False, trust_state=legacy_unaudited, promotion_eligible=False) before a candidate may be consumed; _drain refuses an unstamped pool result before any cycle-log write, and _recent_candidates refuses unstamped pool content before it can enter a memory packet.

_drain no longer attempts capital_tracker.record_experiment or coverage_map.update_from_entry writes; concentration projections are read through check_concentration_violation/check_coverage_imbalance and only feed advisory director reasons, never an execution gate.

p7_authorized=false, campaign_authorized=false, final_holdout_authorized=false, auto_advance=false; no real data/KBase read or update, no scheduler/ACL mutation, no daily update/backtest/research/campaign/holdout started.

advisories.detail: A candidate_pool.yaml containing any unstamped entry now fails closed when read by the runner; existing legacy pools that predate stamping would need a control-plane migration before the runner can consume them.

The legacy director path still writes stamped director_decisions.yaml and strategy_state deltas; quarantining those surfaces is outside this slice and belongs to the later control-plane composition slices.
